remarks: This beautiful home with undeniable curb appeal crafted by Andy Frank, sits on a flat, centrally located acre in the heart of Westport. Designed with light-filled spaces and an open, eat in kitchen, the home is finished across 4 levels, offering versatile living for today's lifestyle. The primary suite flows into a large sitting area with a lovely deck overlooking the pristine backyard. Enjoy 5 additional bedrooms, sun drenched interiors, private home office with patio, and a walk-out lower level perfect for recreation or guest space. Outside, in the fully-fenced backyard, there is an 18x42 pool by RI pools with safety cover and spa, fire-pit, outdoor shower, kitchen and a huge play area which creates a private retreat, ideal for all seasons. A whole house generator ensures comfort and peace of mind year-round. Blending timeless design, functionality and location this Westport gem truly checks every box.
